```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Fetch server data from database
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../assets/data/site_data.db")
server <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT * FROM servers
  WHERE server_name = 'TEST-APP-01'
")
dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Description

Quality assurance and testing application server running automated test suites and performance benchmarks. Hosts staging environments for pre-production validation and user acceptance testing. Supports load testing infrastructure to validate system behavior under stress conditions. Provides isolated environment for security penetration testing and vulnerability assessments. Critical gate in our software delivery pipeline ensuring quality standards before production deployment.
:::
:::

## Server Specifications

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(DT)

# Create the specs data for the table
specs_data <- data.frame(
  Specification = c("Server Name", "Environment", "CPU Cores", "RAM (GB)",
                    "Storage (TB)", "Uptime (%)", "Current Load (%)",
                    "Location", "Status", "Health", "Total Capacity Score"),
  Value = c(
    server$server_name,
    server$environment,
    as.character(server$cpu_cores),
    as.character(server$ram_gb),
    as.character(server$storage_tb),
    paste0(round(server$uptime_pct, 2), "%"),
    paste0(server$current_load_pct, "%"),
    server$location,
    server$status,
    server$health,
    as.character(round(server$total_capacity_score, 2))
  )
)

datatable(specs_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 15,
            searching = FALSE,
            ordering = FALSE,
            dom = 't',
            columnDefs = list(list(width = '40%', targets = 0),
                             list(width = '60%', targets = 1))
          ),
          colnames = c("", ""),
          rownames = FALSE,
          class = 'cell-border stripe')
```
